authority.scope: One preliminary integration prototype; demonstrate separate member/fitting geometry and fixed support packaging before transferring comparable fidelity to retained alternatives. No architecture, commercial component, travel limit, manufacturing release or review baseline is selected.

evidence_boundary.starting_observation: Reopened nominal tube subtotal 0.20629912872141773 kg at assumed CFRP density 1600 kg/m^3; eleven reported tube-overlap pairs remain unacceptable as assembly joints.
evidence_boundary.restriction: Do not transfer the old subtotal or clearance observations to this new geometry. Recompute from actual generated and reopened solids.
evidence_boundary.new_dimensions: Every fitting, support, bore, engagement, material density and numeric tolerance below is an explicit preliminary engineering hypothesis, not supplier data or human-approved physical acceptance.
evidence_boundary.execution: Writing this configuration does not execute CAD or verification.

units_and_frames.restriction: Partial structural CG is not the complete neutral vehicle CG or the fixed mission datum.

immutable_reference_geometry.moving_ownership: Both rotor slabs and all retained yoke reference primitives belong to the inner gimbal group. Fixed supports, landing structure and spine belong to the airframe.
immutable_reference_geometry.restriction: Do not move these datums, shrink the retained envelopes or reduce the sampled travel to obtain a pass.

construction_coordinates.v_plus_minus: unit(J-B_plus_minus), directed from brace root toward J
construction_coordinates.brace_manufactured_endpoints: B to J-70*v; explicitly shortened from the old untrimmed B-to-J chord
construction_coordinates.restriction: J remains a construction junction, not a requirement for three tube solids to occupy the same material. Keep old untrimmed geometry as a non-mass diagnostic only. Report any residual tube overlap rather than increasing cutback automatically.

integral_main_root_sockets.bore_interval: A-15*u to A+15*u, open at the downstream mouth

integral_brace_root_sockets.bore_interval: B to B+30*v, open at the downstream mouth

printed_root_ring_spider.construction: Union only the intentionally continuous printed annulus, hub, spokes and integral socket bosses, then cut the specified bores through every affected portion of that same printed part. Do not fuse CFRP tubes into it. Require a connected positive-volume solid; report disconnected bosses or insufficient webs.
printed_root_ring_spider.manufacturing_limit: One-piece print-bed fit, print orientation, anisotropy, shrinkage and practical assembly access are unverified. Splitting this part later needs explicit joints and revised mass/procurement.

brace_junction_fittings.branch_socket_axis_interval: J-110*v to J-67*v for each brace
brace_junction_fittings.branch_bore_interval: J-110*v to J-70*v; mouth open upstream
brace_junction_fittings.connecting_web_hypothesis: For each branch, add a radius-5 mm cylindrical web between J-90*v and its orthogonal projection on the main-tube axis. Union it only within this single printed fitting, then subtract all main and branch bores from the entire fitting.
brace_junction_fittings.construction: Each fitting remains separate from the continuous main tube and both shortened braces. Require actual bore separation, connected material, insertion access and absence of tube-tube overlap. Do not interpret a Boolean union of fitting features as proof of joint strength.
brace_junction_fittings.assembly: Slide fitting over the main tube before installing the foot; insert each shortened brace into its branch socket. Dry-assembly sequence and bond application access remain to be demonstrated.

fixed_gimbal_supports.construction: Each support is one deliberately continuous printed beam/column/housing. Cut its axial bore through all overlapping support material. Keep supports separate from the root ring. The top beam contacts the ring underside at Z=427.
fixed_gimbal_supports.load_path: Leg roots and central spider to ring/support attachment, top beam, outboard column and outer-axis bearing housing. This represents only the fixed-side path terminating at the provisional outer bearing interface.
fixed_gimbal_supports.interface_limit: The 12 mm bore is an exploratory aperture, not a sourced bearing seat. Bearings, shafts, fasteners, outer moving carrier, inner pivots and actuator connections are unresolved; no complete gimbal load-path or actuator-feasibility claim is permitted.
fixed_gimbal_supports.restriction: Do not attach fixed columns directly to the inner moving yoke. All support solids must be checked against every retained moving-envelope primitive.

spine_pedestal.interface: Base contacts the central spider at Z=433; spine begins at the axial stop Z=450. Mounting fasteners and secondary spine retention remain unresolved.

foot_bodies.construction: Union the base and socket only within each printed foot, then cut the inclined bore through the entire part. Preserve the tube's F+5*u endpoint and a nominal 3 mm axial end wall. Check that no tube or foot body extends below its pad interface.

foot_pads.interface: Separate solids contacting printed feet at Z=6; actual pad product, attachment, friction and compression unknown. Their finite footprint replaces point markers for new rigid-ground observations without changing nominal contact-center datums.

bond_and_retention_hypotheses.modelled_bond_layers: Create separate annular adhesive solids over each specified tube engagement, using tube OD and socket bore radius. At each junction include the continuous-main-tube sleeve and both branch sockets. Record actual layer volume, intersections and mass once.
bond_and_retention_hypotheses.primary_load_transfer: Bonded socket/sleeve surfaces and the stated axial end stops are preliminary load-transfer hypotheses, not qualified retention.
bond_and_retention_hypotheses.positive_secondary_retention: Unresolved. Do not claim compliance or flight readiness from adhesive geometry alone. Compare straps, collars or appropriate mechanical retention without assuming unsupported CFRP cross-drilling or crushing loads.
bond_and_retention_hypotheses.fastener_geometry: Unresolved custom attachment patterns and commercial fasteners remain separately identified omissions. Do not invent vendor mounting patterns or hide missing fasteners by merging separate printed parts.
bond_and_retention_hypotheses.assembly_risk: Blind sockets, integral root fittings and the braced topology may overconstrain insertion. Demonstrate an assembly sequence or report failure before calling the assembly realizable.

material_and_mass_ownership.provenance: Modelling assumptions only; no supplier-certified density, laminate properties, printed-part strength or adhesive compatibility is established.
material_and_mass_ownership.physical_sum: Sum each final manufactured solid and separately modelled adhesive layer exactly once. Use solid-level volume, centroid and full inertia, density conversion and the parallel-axis theorem. Report per-material and per-part contributions.

hardware_allowances.item: ring-to-support and pedestal fasteners, washers and locking hardware
hardware_allowances.status: unquantified; excluded from geometric subtotal and explicitly missing

hardware_allowances.item: positive secondary tube and pad retention
outer bearings, shafts, carriers, inner pivots, actuators and linkages
hardware_allowances.status: unquantified; interface aperture is not purchased hardware

material_and_mass_ownership.restriction: Do not assign unspecified locations to missing hardware, use supplier mass in addition to the same modelled material, or describe the partial structural subtotal as complete installed mass.

required_geometry_observations.part_validity: Enumerate physical components, solid counts, validity, volumes, connectivity and material assignments; flag detached socket bosses and disconnected printed features.
required_geometry_observations.all_pair_checks: Evaluate physical component intersections and distances without blanket pair exclusions. Record intended contact surfaces individually: tube/end stop, tube/adhesive, adhesive/socket, foot/pad, ring/support and pedestal/spider. Positive interpenetrating volume remains a failure, including on intended-contact pairs.
required_geometry_observations.joint_details: Report brace cut endpoints, minimum tube-tube and bore-bore separation, engagement lengths, residual fitting webs and insertion/access limitations. Geometric connectivity is not structural qualification.
required_geometry_observations.numeric_tolerance_scope: CAD numerical discrimination only, not manufacturing clearance or physical acceptance.

retained_pose_sampling.restriction: Use the retained resultant-cone construction; independently commanding both axes to 15 degrees is not a 15-degree resultant cone.

required_geometry_observations.moving_clearance: Check both rotor slabs and every retained yoke primitive against all new physical tubes, printed structure, adhesive and pad solids, retaining governing poses and witnesses. Separately report the unresolved moving-carrier, actuator and cable geometry.
required_geometry_observations.ground_sampling: Retain body tilt hypotheses 0 and 5 degrees with tilt-axis azimuth every 45 degrees. Determine vertical placement from the actual rigid pad shapes, not merely former point markers. Report body placement, first-contact support feature and rotor minimum Z. No pad compression, dynamic settling or continuous clearance is established.
required_geometry_observations.native_reopen: Reopen the saved FCStd, recompute and perform a documented unsaved parameter perturbation/restoration. Observe connected bore/part behaviour rather than only a changed display value.
required_geometry_observations.STEP_reopen: Read actual exported physical solids; establish component/material correspondence independently of solid order before any heterogeneous-density mass comparison.

procurement_and_comparison.rule: Recompute finished tube cut hypotheses and whole-stock schedules after joint integration. Charge whole minimum purchasable non-exempt hardware/material quantities, excluding shipping and tax. PETG filament alone is cost-exempt; printed mass remains included. Preserve the two-battery purchase rule and separately priced GSE.
procurement_and_comparison.strict_budget_test: complete_vehicle_purchased_hardware_material_cost < 500 AUD, only after all chargeable entries are accounted for
retained_comparators: tripod and quadpod at both rotor/stance hypotheses
procurement_and_comparison.selection_gate: Transfer demonstrated integration methods to retained comparators and reconcile complete installed mass, structural demands, procurement and propulsion energy before structural selection.

execution_contract.method: Create a fresh editable generator with write_text; run the saved source through freecad_run, headless=true. Preserve supplied checkouts and all previous artifacts.
execution_contract.publication: Declare actual generated files in tool outputs and publish them with current requirement/input references.
execution_contract.verification: Retain a separate editable artifact-bound verifier, use verify_command with every tested artifact Ref, and copy the actual returned outcome/explanation into evidence. Process completion alone establishes no acceptance.
execution_contract.failure_policy: Preserve unsuccessful geometry and diagnostics. Do not automatically enlarge joints, move immutable datums, reduce travel or suppress collisions to obtain passing checks.
